sn41.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Kāmabhū Macchikāsaṇḍe viharati Ambāṭakavane || || 2
sn41.5:1.2: Atha kho Citto gahapati yenāyasmā Kāmabhū tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Kāmabhum abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antam nisinnaṃ kho Cittaṃ gahapatim āyasmā Kāmabhū etad avoca || ||
sn41.5:4.1: Imassa nu kho gahapati saṅkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || ||
sn41.5:4.2: Kiṃ nu kho etam bhante Bhagavatā bhāsitan ti || ||
sn41.5:4.4: Tena hi bhante muhuttaṃ āgamehi yāvassa attham pekkhāmī ti || || 4
sn41.5:4.5: Atha kho Citto gahapati muhuttaṃ tuṇhi hutvā āyasmantam Kāmabhum etad avoca || ||
sn41.5:5.1: Nelaṅganti kho bhante sīlānam etam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn41.5:5.2: Setapacchādo ti kho bhante vimuttiyā etam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn41.5:5.3: Ekāro ti kho bhante satiyā etam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn41.5:5.4: Vattatī ti kho bhante abhikkamapaṭikkamassetam adhivacanaṃ || ||
sn41.5:5.5: Rathoti kho bhante imassetam cātumahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ || mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsupacayassa aniccucchādana-parimaddana-bhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammassa || ||
sn41.5:5.6: Rāgo kho bhante nīgho doso nīgho moho nīgho ||
sn41.5:5.7: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālavātthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā ||
sn41.5:5.8: tasmā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu anīgho ti vuccati || ||
sn41.5:5.9: Āyantante kho bhante arahato etam adhivacanam || ||
sn41.5:5.10: Soto ti kho bhante taṇhāyetam adhivacanaṃ ||
sn41.5:5.11: sā khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālavatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatimanuppādadhammā ||
sn41.5:5.12: tasmā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu chinnasoto ti vuccati ||
sn41.5:5.13: Rāgo bhante bandhanaṃ doso bandhanaṃ moho bandhanaṃ ||
sn41.5:5.14: te khīnāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālavatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā ||
sn41.5:5.15: tasmā khīṇāsavo bhikkhu abandhano ti vuccati || || 5
sn41.5:5.16: Iti kho bhante yan tam Bhagavatā vuttaṃ || ||
sn41.5:7.1: Imassa kho bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attham ājānātūti || || 6
sn41.5:7.2: Lābhā te gahapati || suladdhaṃ te gahapati
sn41.5:7.3: yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhuṃ kamatī
